name: Fire Portals

features.name: Cluster tumbles
features.description: Five or more connected symbols win on a 7x7 grid.

features.name: Fire Portal wilds
features.description: Wins spawn wilds that gain +1x and move each time they win.

features.name: Merging wilds
features.description: Wilds in the same cluster merge and combine multipliers.

review:
A 7x7 cluster game with wilds that move and grow. Any win without a Fire Portal wild spawns one inside the winning area, starting at 1x.

Every time a portal wild is part of a win, its multiplier goes up by 1x and it jumps somewhere new – and if two land in the same cluster, they merge and combine. Watching them build up within a single spin is really satisfying. Up to 10,000x, 96.06% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
